events.stem:
The gas-phase sequential isomerization of alkenes occurs in two rigid reaction vessels, A and B, maintained at temperatures [[T_A]] K and [[T_B]] K, respectively:
But-1-ene(g) ⇌ cis-But-2-ene(g)  (Reaction 1)
cis-But-2-ene(g) ⇌ trans-But-2-ene(g)  (Reaction 2)

At equilibrium in vessel A, the partial pressure of but-1-ene is [[p_but1ene_A]] atm and that of cis-but-2-ene is [[p_cis_A]] atm, while the standard Gibbs free energy change for Reaction 2 is [[delta_G2_A]] kJ mol^-1.
At equilibrium in vessel B, the partial pressure of but-1-ene is [[p_but1ene_B]] atm and that of cis-but-2-ene is [[p_cis_B]] atm, while the standard Gibbs free energy change for Reaction 2 is [[delta_G2_B]] kJ mol^-1.

Calculate the ratio of the equilibrium partial pressure ratio (p_trans-but-2-ene / p_but-1-ene) in vessel B to that in vessel A.

(Given: R = [[R]] J K^-1 mol^-1)
events.asks: the ratio of the equilibrium partial pressure of trans-but-2-ene to that of but-1-ene in Reactor B compared to Reactor A

def solve():
    reaction_1 = "But-1-ene(g) ⇌ cis-But-2-ene(g)"

    Kp1_A = step_153(
        balanced_equation=reaction_1,
        partial_pressures={"But-1-ene": p_but1ene_A, "cis-But-2-ene": p_cis_A}
    )["equilibrium_constant"]
    delta_G1_A = step_369(equilibrium_constant=Kp1_A, T=T_A)["delta_g"]
    delta_G_overall_A = delta_G1_A + delta_G2_A
    Kp_overall_A = step_135(delta_g=delta_G_overall_A, T=T_A)["equilibrium_constant"]

    Kp1_B = step_153(
        balanced_equation=reaction_1,
        partial_pressures={"But-1-ene": p_but1ene_B, "cis-But-2-ene": p_cis_B}
    )["equilibrium_constant"]
    delta_G1_B = step_369(equilibrium_constant=Kp1_B, T=T_B)["delta_g"]
    delta_G_overall_B = delta_G1_B + delta_G2_B
    Kp_overall_B = step_135(delta_g=delta_G_overall_B, T=T_B)["equilibrium_constant"]

    return Kp_overall_B / Kp_overall_A
